# ‘Unstoppable rise of China’ fuels Mandarin learning boom in Cambodia

As Chinese investment surges in the country, locals see language skills as vital to business opportunities and economic growth

Published: 1:11pm, 17 Apr 2025 Updated: 3:17pm, 17 Apr 2025

Watching Chinese money flow into his home city of Sihanoukville, Cambodian linguist Um Keangseng opened a language school to meet the growing demand for Mandarin lessons.

Sihanoukville has been the biggest recipient of Chinese investment into Cambodia, where President Xi Jinping arrived on Thursday.

“Every province has Chinese investors,” said Um Keangseng, who founded his school a decade ago to address the market for skilled communicators.
